d: Short, shaggy jet black hair with choppy bangs frames a youthful, adolescent face with narrow, olive green eyes. A slender build is dressed in a form-fitting black turtleneck paired with a silver dog-tag necklace, silver rings on the fingers, and a silver bracelet on the left wrist. A white and blue oversized jacket with geometric patterns is worn draped off the shoulders. Resting on the forehead is a pair of white-rimmed circular glasses.
